links.outcome: Accuracy and hallucination rate of AI summaries reviewed against source hepatology referral records
links.effect: AI summaries had high accuracy (median 94.6% [IQR 86.5%-97.3%]) with a low hallucination rate.
links.quote: AI summaries had high accuracy (median [interquartile range]: 94.6% [86.5%-97.3%]) with a low hallucination rate.

links.outcome: Time to triage AI summary files versus original referral files
links.effect: 60% reduction in triage time; adjusted mean 37.2 seconds for AI files vs 94.2 seconds for original files, P < 0.001.
links.quote: Use of the AI summaries led to a 60% reduction in triage time (adjusted mean triage time of 37.2 seconds for AI files vs 94.2 seconds for original files, P < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Iterative prompt engineering with a predefined list of required data elements for LLM summarization of referral documents

screen.reason: Empirical study testing the clinical workflow impact (triage time and accuracy) of an LLM summarization tool compared to standard review of referral records; it does not test a specific deployment safeguard/guardrail practice.
